welcome.title: Welcome to Applo
welcome.description: In a few minutes we'll show you how your profile and a job posting turn into a finished application — whatever your industry or profession.
bullets: Set up your profile once — Applo reuses it for every application.
Add a job posting and have your cover letter and CV generated.
Fine-tune the documents in the editor and download them as PDFs.

profile.title: Create your profile or import your CV
profile.description: Your profile is the basis for every application. Uploading a CV you already have is the quickest way to start.
bullets: Upload your CV as a PDF or Word file — positions, qualifications and skills are imported automatically.
Add work experience, education, certificates, projects and languages — whether you're a nurse, a machine operator or a sales manager.
The more complete your profile, the more accurate the generated documents.

jobs.title: Add a job posting & find jobs
jobs.description: Applo reads the posting and recognises the position, the company and the requirements.
bullets: Paste the posting as text, provide a link or upload a file.
Or browse the built-in job search for suitable positions.
Every saved posting can be reused for another application later.

generate.title: Generate an application
generate.description: Combine your profile with a job posting — Applo writes a cover letter and a CV tailored to the role.
bullets: The assistant guides you through it in a few steps.
The status moves from queued to generating to ready on its own — you can leave the page in the meantime.
Key terms from the posting are woven in so your documents also pass applicant tracking systems (ATS).

editor.title: PDF editor & design templates
editor.description: Polishing without a word processor: adjust the content, pick a design, export.
bullets: Edit the cover letter and CV right in the editor — with AI support for individual sections.
Several ATS-friendly templates plus accent colour, font and line spacing.
Export as a PDF, in another language if you need one.

check.title: Application check
check.description: Have documents you created outside Applo reviewed before you send them off.
bullets: Paste your CV and, optionally, your cover letter — you can add the job posting as context.
You get an ATS assessment, your strengths and concrete suggestions for improvement.

interviews.title: Interview coach
interviews.description: Practise interviews — in writing via chat or out loud with an AI interviewer.
bullets: The questions are based on your profile and the role.
Your answers are scored and you get concrete feedback.
In voice mode you speak the interview just like the real thing.

tracking.title: Email tracking
tracking.description: Applo spots replies from companies in your inbox and updates the application status automatically.
bullets: Connect your mailbox once (currently Microsoft/Outlook).
Incoming replies are matched to the right application.
No email content is stored — only the detected status.

done.title: You're all set — good luck!
done.description: You now know the most important parts of Applo.
bullets: You can restart this tour any time via “Help & tour” in the sidebar.
You will also find it in the settings under “Preferences”.
Next step: complete your profile and create your first application.
